newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks climb in morning, follow Dow rebound.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks climb in morning, follow Dow rebound.

text.p: Tokyo stocks climbed early in the Tuesday morning session following a rebound in the Dow industrials overnight as well as a rise in Nikkei futures in Chicago. However brokers said sentiment was weak and gains could be short lived.
As of 0017 GMT, the Nikkei average was up 115.41 points, or 0.65 percent, at 17,807.88. Its June futures were 180 points higher at 17,820.
"Wall Street's rebound was rather small and the Nikkei average is still within a 17,300 to 18,000 range," said Hirokichi Matsumura, managing director at Tachibana Securities.
